procedure: Parquet tables: restrict to rows with race_id <= last_race_id (tables with a race_id column) or (season, round) <= (last_season, last_round) (laps, pits). Columns sorted by name (the columns listed here must all still exist; extra columns are ignored). Row hash = pandas.util.hash_pandas_object(df[columns], index=False) (uint64). Group digest = sha256 of the sorted uint64 row hashes of the group (little-endian bytes); groups = race_id, or season+round. File digest = same over all restricted rows. CSV tables: read with dtype=str, keep_default_na=False; row hash = sha256 of the cell values joined by U+001F; the first n_rows rows must be unchanged and in the same order (rows may be appended). Generated once, from files whose raw SHA-256 equals the FREEZE.md value (checked at generation). The check passes only if every group digest, the file digest and every frozen CSV row match.
